race.comment: Tricky race to assess with a few of these facing the starter for the first time. Of the raced brigade WEOWNACHEVY (11) is unlucky to still be a maiden placing in both outings to date and strikes a winnable contest here. Gets in well at the weights with the 3kg claim and should be right there when the judge calls a halt. Former Victorian CAPTAIN BLOOD (3) is having his first run for the new yard but showed ability down south and trust that Gollan has him up to the mark following two recent trials. Rates a leading prospect. VUKAS (10) is on debut but looked handy winning a trial here and gets Thompson on board from a low draw. Respect any market confidence. RED POINT (6) just missed the frame at Eagle Farm on debut and will have derived a stack of benefit from that race day experience. In the mix. THREEEYEDWITCH (7) has hit the top-four in all five starts to date and may earn some minor money again.
